simpleloot.title: Simple Loot
simpleloot.option.enableVaultCooldown.to:
Allow repeat vault rewards after the server
cooldown. Disable to retain Vanilla one-time
rewards. Default: true.
simpleloot.option.vaultCooldownDays.tool:
Time in Minecraft days until a player can
loot a vault again. Default: 100. Allowed
range: 1–36500.
